The StatsML official website at the pinned 2026-07-31 commit explicitly requires separability, first countability, and pointwise continuity in the parameter before the complete formula, and directly names the before root after it. This target predates issue77/PR78, so there is no need to reconstruct the function-class scope by translating back from the formal statement. The after root replaces the topological assumptions with PointwiseSeparable, but the existing dependency PointwiseSeparable.of_continuous derives this from a separable Fréchet–Urysohn parameter space and pointwise continuity, and first countability implies Fréchet–Urysohn. Thus the after version covers every function class in the source; the complexity and conclusion are unchanged.
